what: 16-bit JRPG boss fights as a musical instrument. Play a riff on the keyboard and your three-hero party—Fighter, Cleric, and Sorceress—weaves it into a live fantasy battle soundtrack across nine pixel-art realms, while bosses wind up drum-roll counter-attacks that curse your beat, harmony, and screen. Shape the fight in real time with spell buttons and knobs.
author: Brian Provost
